title: Symbiotic Relationships
definition: The interdependence and coevolution of two distinct entities, in this case the CADMIES tools and human indexing.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a garden where tools like a shovel and a hoe work together with the gardener. Sometimes, trying to bypass the tools can lead to messy gardens.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: In the CADMIES knowledge system, the automated tools and human manual indexing are symbiotic. Ignoring the tools and writing around them can cause inconsistencies and errors, just like using the wrong tool in a garden.
difficulty_levels.expert: The symbiotic relationship between automated tools and manual indexing in CADMIES highlights the ongoing debate in human-AI collaboration. Balancing automation and human intervention is a complex task with philosophical implications. It also connects to the broader field of artificial general intelligence, where the relationship between intelligent systems and their creators is a central theme.

extra_fields.insight: The necessity of using the provided tools in CADMIES for consistent and error-free indexing.
